title: Prayer & Prophecy Service — Set the Week
excerpt: Mondays 6–7PM — corporate prayer, prophecy and impartation to chart the course of the week.
body: Join us every Monday 6–7PM for an hour of intense prayer, prophecy and the Word. Come early, come expectant — your week is set in the place of prayer.

title: Special Miracle Service with Healing & Impartation
excerpt: A time of worship, Word, healing, and supernatural impartation. Come expectant.
body: Join us for a special Sunday of worship, teaching, healing and impartation. Ministers from across PH Zone 3 will be present. Invite family and friends. Children and teens programmes run concurrently.

title: City-Wide Cell Outreach — December Edition
excerpt: Our cells take the Gospel to streets, campuses, and communities.
body: All cell leaders and members will be reaching out with Rhapsody of Realities, love gifts, and invitations to church. Sign up in your cell to participate.

title: Praise Night — End of Year Thanksgiving
excerpt: An evening of thanksgiving, worship, and testimonies.
body: Choir, dance, drama, and congregation worship as we close the year in gratitude. Free and open to all.

title: Foundation School Graduation
excerpt: Celebrating new graduates from our 6-week Foundation School.
body: Family invited. Graduates should arrive by 4:30PM for robing. Certificates and awards presented.

title: ReachOut World 2026 — Rhapsody Distribution Drive
excerpt: Join thousands distributing Rhapsody of Realities across our city.
body: Partner, volunteer, or sponsor copies. Materials available at the Partnership Office.
